EventPhenotype: Base class for identifying patients by any clinical event in a database domain.
CodelistPhenotype: Identifies patients by matching against a list of medical codes (ICD, NDC, CPT, etc.).
MeasurementPhenotype: Identifies patients by numerical measurement values such as lab results or vital signs.
CategoricalPhenotype: Identifies patients by categorical values such as sex, ethnicity, or hospitalization type.
AgePhenotype: Derives patient age at a specific point in time from birth date data.
DeathPhenotype: Identifies patients with a recorded death event.
LogicPhenotype: Combines multiple phenotypes using logical operators (AND, OR, NOT).
ArithmeticPhenotype: Calculates a numerical value from other numerical phenotypes (e.g., BMI from height and weight).
ScorePhenotype: Computes a medical score by combining phenotypes with addition, subtraction, or multiplication.
BinPhenotype: Converts a numerically valued phenotype into categorical bins.
EventCountPhenotype: Counts the number of distinct days a phenotype event occurs.
MeasurementChangePhenotype: Identifies a change in a numerical measurement value between two time points.
WithinSameEncounterPhenotype: Filters events to those co-occurring within the same clinical encounter.
TimeRangePhenotype: Identifies continuous observation periods such as insurance coverage windows.
TimeRangeCountPhenotype: Counts the number of distinct observation periods a patient has.
TimeRangeDayCountPhenotype: Counts the total number of days within qualifying observation periods.
TimeRangeDaysToNextRange: Calculates the number of days until the next observation period begins.
FurtherValueFilterPhenotype: Applies additional value filtering on top of an existing phenotype.
UserDefinedPhenotype: Executes a custom user-defined function to identify patients.
